stories.text: 🚨 MEDIAN FLIP: Ramosverse just moved below the projected league median.
🎯 PLAYOFF SWING: The Mahomies vs Mr. Action Jackson. Playoff odds with a win / loss: The Mahomies 33% / 6.4%, Mr. Action Jackson 47% / 17%.

🤝 HINDSIGHT DEPT.: 4 weeks ago we said The Mahomies should get Bo Nix and Parker Washington from Ramosverse. Since: Bo Nix and Parker Washington 108.04 pts, Devaughn Vele and Jeremiyah Love 25.80 pts.
🎯 TWO WINS: Beautiful Dark Twisted Fantasy: 80% playoff odds with 2 wins this week, 38% with none (now 68%).
📈 LINE MOVE: PIT @ PHI: PHI −5.5 at open, PIT −4.5 now. News: "Sources: Steelers G Mason McCormick avoided fracture, won't need ankle surgery"
🏟️ Game to watch: IND @ HOU (Thursday 8:15 PM), 11 league starters in action with 134.16 pts up for grabs. It could swing Ramosverse vs Kyle Tucker by 21%.
📺 Up next, Thursday 8:15 PM (IND @ HOU): 11 league starters in action. Most riding on it: The Mahomies vs Mr. Action Jackson (44.00 pts projected).
🔢 MAGIC NUMBER: Brock You Like a Hurricane clinches a first-round bye with 2 more wins. A sweep this week (beat 49er Faith-Fool and the median) does it.
🪑 Bench of broken dreams: The Mahomies has yet to start Antonio Williams. Starting him in Weeks 8 and 10 would have meant 3 more wins by now (+20.30 pts).
🤝 Rivalry week: Claremont In Yo Stace! leads Gibb it to Me Baby 4–2 all-time.
🗞️ Fresh off the wire: Ruffing the Passer added Jacory Croskey-Merritt (RB, projected 7.61 pts), plus 2 more pickups.
📈 Stock rising: 49er Faith-Fool has its ESPN projection trending up.
📈 Beautiful Dark Twisted Fantasy was down to 7.2% against The Mahomies — and won.
💓 49er Faith-Fool outlasted TDsMaGee after the favorite flipped 3 times.
